usage: The word '年' (nin4) is used to specify the year in dates.
'年' can be combined with numbers to express specific years, like '2024年'.
When talking about age, '年' indicates how many years old someone is.
You can use '年' to refer to a duration or period of one year.
'年' usually appears before units like 月 (month) and 日 (day) in full dates.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 nin4 ji6 sap6 ng5 nin4.
examples.meaning: I am 25 years old this year.
